title: THE WHAT IS NEW CARD NAMES HIS NOTES OF OCTOBER 7
why: The card was stamped v18.68 and the stamp may not trail the build by more than 0.15. Its new second line names what came of his notes of October 7: the Overseer health bar, the bandage and plate bar, the scope zoom and the FASHION previews.
now: The what is new card names the changes from his October 7 notes.

edits.anchor: 'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
edits.replacement:
'THIS IS AN ALPHA. Things will break. When something does, the game writes it into your run report and tells you so; that report is how it gets fixed.',
  'YOUR NOTES OF OCTOBER 7. The Overseer health bar waits until you have seen him. Bandages, medkits and plates show a bar above your belt. Scoped guns zoom in a little when you aim. FASHION shows every outfit, face, tattoo and hairstyle on your own operator.',
